book.name: EFESUS
book.title: EFESUS Efesus mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Ina mam le kiŋo kame tuku pasa
Kiŋo kame, tane Kuate tuku nzali dubimba ina mam kumnemŋge minap. Maŋau ta tiŋreknu.
Tukul pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ina mam tuku nyu kurauka miŋge kumnemŋge minap. Tane taŋawap ta kilke te mbolŋge ait kuen mine mayenu mbolŋge minamŋgaig ŋga sakate. Lo 5.16

content: Tukul ta suŋgokanu. Kuate nu te-mayokmba dubikade mbal wam mayenu tam tuku sakina.
Taŋgo kame, tane taŋgine kiŋo kame ndagariniŋgam tuku sigair sigair ndaniŋgap. Tane Kuate tuku nzali dubimba naŋgine mbar kile-tidiŋga wam magenu ndo tumniŋgap.
Piro taŋgo le piro kulat mbal tuku pasa
Piro taŋgo, tane taŋgine kulat mbal tuku nyu idusniŋmba kurauka nane kumnemŋge minap. Tane Kristus kumnemŋge minig taŋamba ndo taŋgine kulat mbal kumnemŋge minmba wamdus tugusekmbi pirokap.
Tane kulatkade mbal am mbolŋge nane nzaliniŋgam tuku ndo piro ndakap. Tane Kristus tuku piro mbal taŋaŋ minig tukunu wamdus gare ŋakmbi Kuate tuku nzali dubimba pirokap.
Sine Suŋgo tuku piro keg ŋga gare ŋak pirokap sulumba taŋgo tuku piro ndo keg ŋga idus ndawap.
Piro taŋgo ko piro kulat taŋgo nu wam mayenu kate ta Suŋgo nu kumumbi lafuwamŋgat ta tane kila.

Piro kulat mbal, tane mata taŋgine piro mbal mbolŋge wam magenu ndo kap. Tane ŋerŋerka pasa pitinu sa ndaniŋgap. Tane taŋgine piro mbal ndoŋ taŋgine Suŋgo ndindo samba mbolŋge minit. Nu taŋgo ŋakmba mbolŋge maŋau kumumbi kate ta tane kila. Nu ande kusre ndate.
Sine Kuate tuku kame agaŋ ŋak minbe
Kile ye pasa ndindo satiŋgam tuku minit. Tane Suŋgo ndoŋ ulendika nu tuku saŋgri ta mbolŋge saŋgri tiŋgap.
Tane Satan tuku yabri wamdus kila suŋgo ta te-ibeŋam tuku Suŋgo tuku kame agaŋ ŋakmba silike likap.
Sine taŋgo ndoŋ kame bumba mine ndakeg. Kuga. Sine bukla kame guwa ŋaigonu tuku sugo sugo ma make tuku gabat kame ta ŋakmba ndoŋ kame bumba mineg.
Ta tuku tane Kuate tuku kame agaŋ ŋakmba sili ŋak likap. Tane taŋawap ta kame ait mbolŋge tane saŋgri tiŋga minig le ka kame kugate ta baklel ndade.
Tane kame tuku kuaneka tugusek maŋau let taŋaŋ tiŋgap. Maŋau tiŋreknu tawo soŋgam tuku agaŋ taŋaŋ tumba silikap.
Tane Kristus tuku pasa mayenu mbolŋge ŋgamuŋgal mukuk tade ta kupe ŋgaro kareŋnu taŋaŋ patikap.
Tane kame agaŋ ŋakmba ta silika Satan tuku tui pa bulu ŋak saŋgri pitaiwam tuku Kuate nu kumuŋ ŋga nu tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgade wam ta kandim taŋaŋ tap.
Kuate nu tane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgit wam ta hat kareŋnu taŋaŋ kaikap sulumba Tukul Guwa tuku kame bagi tap. Kame bagi ta Kuate tuku pasa.
Tane mara mara Tukul Guwa mbolŋge Kuate suŋgomba yabaŋmba minap. Tane kanyum ndamba Kuate sarsarmba nu tuku mbal ŋakmba tuku yabaŋap.
Tane ye tuku mata Kuate yabaŋap le nu ye tuku miŋge bul serwa. Taŋawa le ye kuru kuru kugatok Kristus tuku pasa mayenu tuku wam kame buk kuirok minnaig ta kile-mayokki.
Ye pasa mayenu tuku kukul taŋgo minet tukunu ye muliŋtanu wande te mbolŋge minet. Tane Kuate yabaŋap le ye kuru kuru kugatok kumumbi pasa ta kukliwi.
Siŋgine tira Tikikus nu Suŋgo tuku piro kulat mayete ta nu tane tugum promba ye sine ŋakmba mineg maŋau te kubeu tiŋguwa le tane kila palmbimŋgaig.
Nuŋge tane kila satiŋmba tane tuku wamdus bul sertiŋguwa ŋga idusmba nu kukulet.
Mam Kuate siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nale tane siŋgine tira ŋakmba turtiŋguwaik le tane ŋgamuŋgal mukuk kume pur maŋau ŋgamuŋgal son saŋgrinu turmba ŋak minap.
Tane siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku kume purmba minmba minig mbal Kuate nu tane make patikuwa. Son.
